P1.name: Event-Loop Liveness (/health probe under async load)
P1.target: async /health probe P95 <= 500 ms with 0 probe failures across all user tiers

P2.name: Concurrency Throughput Scaling (async-warm > async-cold vs sync)
P2.target: async-warm RPS > async-cold RPS and > sync RPS; cold RPS bounded by CPU retrieval + GPU serialization

P3.name: Warm Cache Replay Latency & SSE Time-To-First-Token (TTFT)
P3.target: async-warm non-stream P50 substantially below async-cold P50; SSE TTFT captured cleanly

P4.name: Saturation Reliability & Graceful Degradation (u >= 50)
P4.target: 0 empty-answer responses; warm saturation error rate <= 5%; graceful 503 degradation over crashes

E5.name: GPU VRAM Hard Cap & Guardrail Telemetry
E5.target: vram_breached == false and peak VRAM <= 5,478 MiB (soft target <= 4,710 MiB)

E6.name: Bounded GPU Semaphore(20), Retrieval Serialization & Head-of-Line Isolation
E6.target: Async event loop remains unblocked while Semaphore(20) and CPU serialization bound GPU/CPU admission

E7.name: Cache-Hit Distribution, Stampede Guard & Failure Accounting
E7.target: Warm cache hits + stampede coalescing active; 0 empty answers; structured failure breakdown

raw_rag_errors.name: /rag/sync[cold]
raw_rag_errors.error: CatchResponseError('HTTP 502: {"status":"UPSTREAM_FAILURE","detail":"GPU VRAM exceeded hard limit 5478 MiB."}')
